title: Rabbi Chunya, father-in-law of Rabbi Ami
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Yalkut Shimoni, I Kings, section 179](https://www.sefaria.org/Yalkut_Shimoni_on_Nach.179.2). Hyman calls this a scribal error, identifying its source as [Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:10 (Hyman cites 1:11)](https://www.sefaria.org/Shir_HaShirim_Rabbah.1.1.10), which reads Rabbi Yannai, father-in-law of Rabbi Ami. Thus we find in [Chullin 111a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.111a.2) that Rabbi Ami had a son named Yannai.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Yalkut has Chunya and Shir HaShirim Rabbah has Yannai in the parallel discussion of the order of Solomon’s books. Hyman explains Chunya as an error.
The Chullin passage names Yannai as Rabbi Ami’s son. Hyman draws a connection between that name and his proposed reading for Ami’s father-in-law.
